title: Writing
standfirst: Spelling, word order, translation and punctuation — the one where accents count.

sections.title: Writing
format: Spell the key words — I live, my name is, and the rest.
Put jumbled words back into order to make a sentence.
Translate five short sentences into French.
sections.advice: The teacher's advice: learn the spellings of all the key phrases, start early, and get someone to test you. Spelling will matter.
